title: An Interview With the Man Behind Trump’s Current Immigration Crackdown

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是 Benjamin Poulin，我是 Mark Ronson，欢迎收听《The Reframers》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片打碟的那个年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着 300 件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，把 DJ 台变成一个充满 50 年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《The Reframers》吧。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的 Natalie Kittroweff。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《The Daily》节目。

sentences.zh: 有个孩子！

sentences.zh: 看那场抓捕，他们正试图把婴儿从她怀里抢走。

sentences.zh: 我的孩子在后座抱着婴儿，他什么都没做。

sentences.zh: 妈妈，你还好吗，妈妈？

sentences.en: As the Trump administration ramps up its crackdown on illegal immigration, it's turned to one agency and one man officials believe can help them dramatically increase deportations.
sentences.zh: 随着特朗普政府加大对非法移民的打击力度，他们将目光转向了一个机构和一个人，官员们认为他能帮助他们大幅增加驱逐出境的人数。

sentences.en: Border Patrol Chief Greg Bovino.
sentences.zh: 边境巡逻队负责人 Greg Bovino。

sentences.en: Arrest as many people that touch you as you want to.
sentences.zh: 想逮捕多少接触你的人都可以。

sentences.en: Those are the general orders.
sentences.zh: 这就是总方针。

sentences.en: He's the law enforcement figure who's now at the center of the most aggressive raids and tactics being employed in American cities.
sentences.zh: 他就是那位执法人物，如今正处于美国城市中实施的最激进突袭和战术的核心。

sentences.en: Why are your officers asking me where I'm from?
sentences.zh: 为什么你们的警官在问我从哪里来？

sentences.en: I thought you guys were doing targeted arrests.
sentences.zh: 我以为你们是在进行针对性逮捕。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Hamid Ali-Aziz speaks to Bovino and explains why his militaristic approach may be here to stay.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事 Hamid Ali-Aziz 将采访 Bovino，并解释为什么他这种军事化的手段可能会长期存在。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, November 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 11 月 12 日，星期三。

sentences.en: Hamid, we're now almost 10 months into the Trump administration's crackdown on immigration.
sentences.zh: Hamid，特朗普政府对移民的打击行动已经进行了快 10 个月了。

sentences.en: And over the course of that period, you've come on the show at several points.
sentences.zh: 在这段时间里，你曾多次来到我们的节目。

sentences.en: And you've told us that despite all of the videos that we're seeing of these ICE raids and these arrests and these very aggressive enforcement tactics,
sentences.zh: 你告诉我们，尽管我们看到了所有关于这些移民及海关执法局（ICE）突袭、逮捕和这些极其激进的执法手段的视频，

sentences.en: the administration is actually frustrated internally with the pace, the slow pace they see of deportations.
sentences.zh: 但政府内部实际上对驱逐出境的缓慢进展感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And you've been reporting recently on the changes that they are making to try to address that.
sentences.zh: 你最近一直在报道他们为解决这一问题所做的改变。

sentences.en: So let's start there.
sentences.zh: 那么我们就从这里开始吧。

sentences.en: Walk me through that.
sentences.zh: 给我梳理一下。

sentences.en: Yeah, the Trump administration, when they came in, they promised mass deportations.
sentences.zh: 是的，特朗普政府上台时承诺要进行大规模驱逐。

sentences.en: And as part of that, there was this massive push earlier this year to arrest 3,000 people a day.
sentences.zh: 作为其中的一部分，今年早些时候曾有一项大规模行动，目标是每天逮捕 3000 人。

sentences.en: That was the goal.
sentences.zh: 这就是目标。

sentences.en: And ICE has gone nowhere near that goal.
sentences.zh: 但 ICE 离这个目标还差得很远。

sentences.en: Across the country, typically ICE on a weekday is averaging around 1,300 arrests.
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，ICE 平时工作日的平均逮捕人数约为 1300 人。

sentences.en: And because of the inability to get these numbers, there have been constant changes at ICE.
sentences.zh: 由于无法达到这些数字，ICE 内部一直在不断进行调整。

sentences.en: And not just recently, but throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是最近，而是贯穿了整个一年。

sentences.en: They've replaced their director.
sentences.zh: 他们更换了局长。

sentences.en: They've replaced multiple senior officials.
sentences.zh: 他们更换了多名高级官员。

sentences.en: And a couple weeks ago, they got rid of almost half of the senior leaders across the country.
sentences.zh: 几周前，他们解雇了全国近一半的高级领导人。

sentences.en: Just to drill down here for a second, what is it that the administration is actually taking issue with?
sentences.zh: 为了深入探讨一下，政府到底对什么不满？

sentences.en: What are these leaders doing wrong, according to the administration?
sentences.zh: 据政府所言，这些领导人做错了什么？

sentences.en: I think one of the main issues here is that the way ICE has historically conducted immigration enforcement is really time intensive.
sentences.zh: 我认为主要问题之一是，ICE 历来执行移民执法的方式非常耗时。

sentences.en: What ICE does is they spend a long time surveilling a single individual.
sentences.zh: ICE 的做法是花很长时间监视某一个人。

sentences.en: They send out several people to go arrest that person.
sentences.zh: 他们派出好几个人去逮捕那个人。

sentences.en: Sometimes that person's not there.
sentences.zh: 有时那个人根本不在那儿。

sentences.en: So there's so many resources.
sentences.zh: 所以为了抓获少数人，投入了太多的资源。

sentences.en: There's so much time just to get a small number of people.
sentences.zh: 花费了太多的时间。

sentences.en: And right now, the administration and DHS and ICE is running into really kind of an inherent issue with the way ICE does its work.
sentences.zh: 而现在，政府、国土安全部和 ICE 正面临着 ICE 工作方式中固有的问题。

sentences.en: It sounds like you're saying they see ICE as actually too methodical, which honestly is sort of hard to square with the images that we've seen of these agents tackling people,
sentences.zh: 听起来你是说他们认为 ICE 实际上太讲究方法了，老实说，这很难与我们看到的那些特工扑倒民众、

sentences.en: slamming people to the ground, breaking families up.
sentences.zh: 把人摔在地上、拆散家庭的画面联系起来。

sentences.en: But then again, we did talk to you a couple months ago about an ICE raid that you and one of our producers went on.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，几个月前我们确实和你谈过一次你和我们的一位制片人参与的 ICE 突袭行动。

sentences.en: And that was this big day-long raid where they only detained three people.
sentences.zh: 那是一次持续一整天的大规模突袭，结果他们只拘留了三个人。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, there have been countless videos.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，已经有无数的视频了。

sentences.en: You see ICE smashing windows to get people.
sentences.zh: 你看到 ICE 砸碎窗户去抓人。

sentences.en: We've seen officer-involved shootings involving ICE.
sentences.zh: 我们见过涉及 ICE 的警员枪击事件。

sentences.en: There are these really dramatic videos of ICE conducting immigration sweeps in the country.
sentences.zh: 这些关于 ICE 在全国范围内进行移民搜捕的视频非常具有戏剧性。

sentences.en: But for ICE, that's the type of drama that they want to avoid.
sentences.zh: 但对 ICE 来说，这正是他们想要避免的那种戏剧性场面。

sentences.en: Typically, what they want to do is they want to secure the scene.
sentences.zh: 通常，他们想要做的是控制现场。

sentences.en: They want to get in and out.
sentences.zh: 他们想速战速决。

sentences.en: And they take a lot of pride in conducting their immigration enforcement in this manner.
sentences.zh: 他们对以这种方式进行移民执法感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: But of course, to pull off a smooth raid, it takes time and planning.
sentences.zh: 但当然，要完成一次顺利的突袭需要时间和计划。

sentences.en: And the agents have to be meticulous in the lead-up.
sentences.zh: 特工们在准备阶段必须非常细致。

sentences.en: And as far as the administration is concerned, time is something that ICE just doesn't have.
sentences.zh: 而就政府而言，时间是 ICE 根本没有的东西。

sentences.en: So they've looked to another agency, and that's Border Patrol.
sentences.zh: 所以他们看向了另一个机构，那就是边境巡逻队。

sentences.en: Border Patrol typically operates near the southern border.
sentences.zh: 边境巡逻队通常在南部边境附近行动。

sentences.en: They are in charge of stopping people who cross into the country illegally.
sentences.zh: 他们负责阻止非法越境进入该国的人。

sentences.en: And they're more willing to be in your face, to be more militaristic in many ways.
sentences.zh: 他们更愿意直面冲突，在许多方面表现得更具军事化色彩。

sentences.en: And they're very aggressive in their approach.
sentences.zh: 而且他们的方法非常激进。

sentences.en: And they've been really behind some of the videos that have gone viral, including, you know, people being chased at Home Depots, raids on apartment buildings,
sentences.zh: 那些在网上疯传的视频背后确实是他们，包括在 Home Depot 追捕人、突袭公寓楼、

sentences.en: people being arrested at car washes.
sentences.zh: 在洗车场逮捕人。

sentences.en: These are Border Patrol, not ICE.
sentences.zh: 这些都是边境巡逻队干的，不是 ICE。

sentences.en: And now the administration wants them to do more and to be really at the forefront of immigration enforcement in the United States.
sentences.zh: 现在政府希望他们做更多的事，并真正站在美国移民执法的最前线。

sentences.en: And the guy that's overseeing all of this, the person who is the commander of this operation, is a guy named Greg Bivino.
sentences.zh: 而监管这一切的人，也就是这次行动的指挥官，是一个叫 Greg Bivino 的人。

sentences.en: Hey, Chief, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嘿，长官，你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm doing good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm doing well.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: So I recently spoke with him to understand his career, where he came from, and why he's been empowered by the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 所以我最近和他谈过，以了解他的职业生涯、他的出身，以及为什么他会受到特朗普政府的重用。

sentences.en: And when you hear his story, it's pretty clear that his whole career has been leading up to this point.
sentences.zh: 当你听到他的故事时，很明显他整个职业生涯都在为这一刻做准备。

sentences.en: And where does that story start for him?
sentences.zh: 他的故事是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: Well, really, at a young age, he's somebody who was drawn to the agency through books, through film.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，他从小就通过书籍和电影被这个机构所吸引。

sentences.en: I'm sure I'm not going to be telling you anything you don't know.
sentences.zh: 我相信我说的这些你肯定都知道。

sentences.en: The game's a little different around here.
sentences.zh: 这里的游戏规则有点不同。

sentences.en: In fact, he had a distant relative.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他有一位远房亲戚。

sentences.en: He calls him an uncle, who was a producer in Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 他称他为叔叔，是一位好莱坞制片人。

sentences.en: Never knew him, but he produced a movie called The Border with Jack Nicholson.
sentences.zh: 虽然从没见过面，但他制作了一部由杰克·尼科尔森主演的电影《边境》（The Border）。

sentences.en: The border.
sentences.zh: 边境。

sentences.en: It divided the land.
sentences.zh: 它分割了土地。

sentences.en: It divided the man.
sentences.zh: 它分割了人性。

sentences.en: And I remember, I believe I was approximately eight, nine years old.
sentences.zh: 我记得，我大概是八九岁的时候。

sentences.en: And my parents took me to see that movie because Uncle Neil produced it.
sentences.zh: 我父母带我去看那部电影，因为 Neil 叔叔制作了它。

sentences.en: It was kind of a big deal from back in rural North Carolina to see something like that.
sentences.zh: 在北卡罗来纳州的农村，能看到那样的东西算是一件大事。

sentences.en: You're killing drivers.
sentences.zh: 你在杀害司机。

sentences.en: Don't tell me I don't know what I'm talking about.
sentences.zh: 别告诉我我不知道自己在说什么。

sentences.en: Because if I don't know what I'm talking about, where's the driver you took in there today?
sentences.zh: 因为如果我不知道自己在说什么，那你今天带进去的那个司机在哪儿？

sentences.en: So we went and watched it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们去看了那部电影。

sentences.en: See this line?
sentences.zh: 看到这条线了吗？

sentences.en: This line right here I don't cross.
sentences.zh: 这条线，我绝不会越过。

sentences.en: This line right here.
sentences.zh: 就是这条线。

sentences.en: It got me interested in the Border Patrol from an early age.
sentences.zh: 这让我从小就对边境巡逻队产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: And I juxtaposed that against the many authors from the 70s and 80s that were from the Border Patrol.
sentences.zh: 我把它与 70 年代和 80 年代许多来自边境巡逻队的作者的作品进行了对比。

sentences.en: They wrote a lot of books.
sentences.zh: 他们写了很多书。

sentences.en: I think he was inspired by an agency in which people are overseeing these vast swaths of land.
sentences.zh: 我想他是被这样一个机构所激励，那里的人们监管着大片的土地。

sentences.en: They're by themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们孤身一人。

sentences.en: The extreme amount of violence that those Border Patrol agents, or they were called inspectors back then, were up againSt.
sentences.zh: 那些边境巡逻队员——当时被称为检查员——所面对的极端暴力。

sentences.en: And it struck me, wow, that was a pretty tough organization to be out there alone with no backup.
sentences.zh: 这让我印象深刻，哇，那是一个相当强悍的组织，可以孤身一人在外而没有后援。

sentences.en: And I began to realize that that thing called the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我开始意识到，那个叫美国边境巡逻队的东西，

sentences.en: Border Patrol is probably something pretty special.
sentences.zh: 可能是一个非常特别的存在。

sentences.en: So I kept it in mind through the years.
sentences.zh: 所以这些年来我一直记着它。

sentences.en: And when I had the opportunity, I put my application in and was accepted.
sentences.zh: 当我有机会时，我提交了申请并被录取了。

sentences.en: And the rest is history.
sentences.zh: 剩下的就是历史了。

sentences.en: And he joins the agency in 1996.
sentences.zh: 他在 1996 年加入了该机构。

sentences.en: And he starts at the El Centro sector, this area near the southern border in California.
sentences.zh: 他从加利福尼亚州南部边境附近的埃尔森特罗（El Centro）区开始工作。

sentences.en: You know, when I started there in El Centro, it was just open desert between the United States and Mexico.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我刚到埃尔森特罗时，美国和墨西哥之间只有一片开阔的沙漠。

sentences.en: And I remember the amount of what we would call a drive-thru.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们所说的“免下车服务”的数量。

sentences.en: That's when someone takes a vehicle and drives across the border, whether it's with a load of illegal aliens or a load of narcotics.
sentences.zh: 那就是有人开车越过边境，无论是载着非法移民还是毒品。

sentences.en: That was quite rampant back in the day there, 30 years ago.
sentences.zh: 30 年前，那里这种情况相当猖獗。

sentences.en: And pretty quickly, he's almost put into the scenario that he imagined as a young man.
sentences.zh: 很快，他就被投入到了他年轻时想象的那种场景中。

sentences.en: You know, this area that's vast swaths of land.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这片区域是大片的土地。

sentences.en: There's not a lot of agents out there.
sentences.zh: 那里没有多少特工。

sentences.en: Or it's oftentimes agents by themselves.
sentences.zh: 或者通常是特工独自一人。

sentences.en: And so he's out there doing the work that he romanticized as a young man, arresting human smugglers, arresting migrants crossing the country illegally,
sentences.zh: 所以他在那里做着他年轻时浪漫化了的工作，逮捕人口走私者，逮捕非法越境的移民，

sentences.en: and really being thrust into these intense scenarios that just years before he was reading in books.
sentences.zh: 真正被推入这些激烈的场景中，而这些场景正是他几年前在书里读到的。

sentences.en: And from there, he was able to rise up in the agency, take on leadership roles across the country, including in New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 从那里开始，他得以在机构中晋升，承担了全国各地的领导职务，包括在新奥尔良。

sentences.en: And ultimately, in 2020, toward the end of the first Trump administration, he returns to El Centro.
sentences.zh: 最终，在 2020 年，在第一届特朗普政府末期，他回到了埃尔森特罗。

sentences.en: And he takes over as Border Patrol agent in charge.
sentences.zh: 他接任了边境巡逻队负责人的职务。

sentences.en: Well, being able to return where I started, that was pretty special.
sentences.zh: 嗯，能够回到我开始的地方，这非常特别。

sentences.en: So there was one area at the border that I thought I knew quite well.
sentences.zh: 边境上有一个区域我以为我很了解。

sentences.en: And once I got down there, I couldn't even recognize it.
sentences.zh: 但当我到了那里，我甚至认不出它了。

sentences.en: It was almost unrecognizable.
sentences.zh: 它几乎变得面目全非。

sentences.en: So I noticed there was a lot more infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 我注意到基础设施多了很多。

sentences.en: President Trump had put the new wall in, the 30-foot wall.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统修建了新墙，那道 30 英尺高的墙。

sentences.en: There's now a wall.
sentences.zh: 现在有了墙。

sentences.en: There are roads.
sentences.zh: 有了道路。

sentences.en: The roads, the technology, the improvements that were made there under President Trump's administration.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统政府领导下，那里修建了道路、技术设施和改进措施。

sentences.en: So that's something I noticed is a much more secure border.
sentences.zh: 所以我注意到的是一个更加安全的边境。

sentences.en: And perhaps most consequentially, the policies are much different.
sentences.zh: 也许最重要的是，政策大不相同。

sentences.en: The Trump administration at this time in 2020 has enacted a sweeping border policy that allows agents to quickly turn back people,
sentences.zh: 当时的特朗普政府在 2020 年颁布了一项全面的边境政策，允许特工迅速遣返人员，

sentences.en: deport them without any process or access to asylum.
sentences.zh: 在没有任何程序或获得庇护机会的情况下将他们驱逐出境。

sentences.en: We finally got what we were asking for.
sentences.zh: 我们终于得到了我们一直要求的。

sentences.en: It's like they finally listened to the Border Patrol.
sentences.zh: 就像他们终于听取了边境巡逻队的意见一样。

sentences.en: And of course, this was in the administration's reasoning as a result of protecting the American public from the spread of COVID.
sentences.zh: 当然，政府给出的理由是保护美国公众免受新冠病毒的传播。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This was Title 42, the measure that allowed them to immediately deport people who tried to cross the border because of the public health emergency.
sentences.zh: 这就是“第 42 条款”（Title 42），这项措施允许他们因为公共卫生紧急情况，立即驱逐试图越境的人。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So it sounds like Bovino is excited by the Trump administration's full-throated approach to enforcement.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来 Bovino 对特朗普政府全力以赴的执法方式感到兴奋。

sentences.en: How does he experience Biden coming to office?
sentences.zh: 他如何看待拜登上台？

sentences.en: And by we, it really means Greg Bovino, who's overseeing the operation.
sentences.zh: 当你被任命为这份工作时，部长对你说了什么？

sentences.en: What did the secretary tell you when she appointed you to this job?
sentences.zh: 她对你的期望说了些什么？

sentences.en: What did she tell you about what she expected?
sentences.zh: 我们希望你有所作为。

sentences.en: We want you to make a difference.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你打击那些走私路线，并将洛杉矶的一些真正坏人和坏事清除出去。

sentences.en: We want you to attack those smuggling routes and remove some of these really bad people and bad things from Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你有所作为。

sentences.en: Go.
sentences.zh: 开始。

sentences.en: This is the Trump administration saying, do this every single day in one of the biggest cities in America.
sentences.zh: 这就是特朗普政府所说的，在全美最大的城市之一，每天都要这样做。

sentences.en: And what does Bovino say about the huge outcry that these tactics elicited?
sentences.zh: 那么博维诺（Bovino）对于这些战术引发的巨大抗议声浪是怎么说的呢？

sentences.en: I mean, we remember the backlash, the protests, the anger, and the sense that a lot of people had that these raids just didn't have a lot of order to them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们还记得当时的反弹、抗议、愤怒，以及许多人觉得这些突袭行动毫无章法的感觉。

sentences.en: That there are these sweeping operations, kind of targeting people seemingly at random.
sentences.zh: 就是那种大规模的扫荡行动，似乎是在随机针对民众。

sentences.en: You know, for him, there is no equivocation.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对他来说，这没有任何含糊之处。

sentences.en: Can you walk me through how you do it?
sentences.zh: 你能带我了解一下你们是怎么做的吗？

sentences.en: How you pick your targets?
sentences.zh: 你们是如何挑选目标的？

sentences.en: How you go about arresting people?
sentences.zh: 你们是如何着手逮捕人的？

sentences.en: Because I think the criticism is that it appears kind of random.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为外界的批评在于，这看起来有点随机。

sentences.en: Can you talk through how you go about picking up people at Home Depot?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈你们是如何在“家得宝”（Home Depot）抓人的吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Hamad, and I'm not going to go too much into the tactics.
sentences.zh: 哈马德（Hamad），我不会过多地谈论战术细节。

sentences.en: But even before we go to a city, we gather intelligence from many different means.
sentences.zh: 但在我们去往一个城市之前，我们通过多种渠道收集情报。

sentences.en: Let's just say that.
sentences.zh: 我们只能说这么多。

sentences.en: So we already know that there are bad people, bad things in certain locations.
sentences.zh: 所以我们已经知道在某些地点有坏人，有坏事发生。

sentences.en: We're going there.
sentences.zh: 我们就会去那里。

sentences.en: We gather our intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我们收集我们的情报。

sentences.en: Bovino says that they are operating on intelligence, that they are targeting people based on their own surveillance.
sentences.zh: 博维诺说他们是根据情报行动的，他们是基于自己的监视来锁定目标的。

sentences.en: And as far as whether or not it's random.
sentences.zh: 至于这是否随机。

sentences.en: Now, if there are other individuals there, they're going to get arrested also.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果那里还有其他人，他们也会被逮捕。

sentences.en: If you're an illegal alien, you're going to get arrested.
sentences.zh: 如果你是非法移民，你就会被逮捕。

sentences.en: He says that if there are other people in the area that we believe are undocumented, they will be arrested as well.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果该地区还有其他人，我们认为他们也是无证件者，他们也会被逮捕。

sentences.en: This is what is often referred to as collaterals, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是通常所说的“连带逮捕”，对吧？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: These are people who are around targets of an immigration operation.
sentences.zh: 这些人只是出现在移民行动目标周围的人。

sentences.en: And when you go to a Home Depot, when you go to a public place where there are a lot of people, the prospect of getting more collateral arrests goes way up.
sentences.zh: 当你去家得宝，当你去人多的公共场所时，发生更多连带逮捕的可能性就会大大增加。

sentences.en: And as part of that, you're going to have the potential to get more numbers, to arrest more people, and go towards that goal that the administration has strived toward,
sentences.zh: 作为其中的一部分，你将有可能获得更多的逮捕人数，逮捕更多的人，并朝着政府一直努力的目标迈进，

sentences.en: which is 3,000 arrests a day.
sentences.zh: 也就是每天逮捕3000人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And for the Trump administration, it's kind of easy to see the appeal of Bovino's approach, especially compared to ICE's more directed version of enforcement.
sentences.zh: 对于特朗普政府来说，博维诺的方法很有吸引力，这很容易理解，尤其是与美国移民及海关执法局（ICE）那种更具针对性的执法方式相比。

sentences.en: By going into big public areas instead of, you know, a single person's home, it's more likely that you're going to detain a bunch of people.
sentences.zh: 通过进入大型公共区域，而不是去某个人的家里，你更有可能拘留一大群人。

sentences.en: Maybe they're people that you weren't originally looking for, but that might help the administration meet its goal of working to deport as many people as possible.
sentences.zh: 也许他们不是你最初寻找的人，但这可能有助于政府实现其尽可能多地驱逐人员的目标。

sentences.en: So my question is, how exactly does Border Patrol decide who to stop when they're there?
sentences.zh: 所以我的问题是，边境巡逻队在现场时，究竟是如何决定拦截谁的？

sentences.en: What's the criteria they use?
sentences.zh: 他们使用的标准是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the way he describes it to me is a process called reasonable suspicion.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他向我描述的方式是一个被称为“合理怀疑”的过程。

sentences.en: That reasonable suspicion is below probable cause.
sentences.zh: 这种“合理怀疑”的标准低于“相当理由”。

sentences.en: Many of your viewers probably understand what probable cause is.
sentences.zh: 你们的许多观众可能了解什么是“相当理由”。

sentences.en: Reasonable suspicion is an even lower standard.
sentences.zh: “合理怀疑”是一个更低的标准。

sentences.en: So to get that reasonable suspicion, we look at things called articulable facts.
sentences.zh: 所以为了获得那种“合理怀疑”，我们观察被称为“可陈述事实”的东西。

sentences.en: And someone's ethnicity is naturally an articulable fact as well.
sentences.zh: 而一个人的族裔自然也是一种可陈述的事实。

sentences.en: It could be, but that's the case-by-case basis, Hamad.
sentences.zh: 这可能是，但那是具体情况具体分析的，哈马德。

sentences.en: There's not a blanket articulable fact sheet that we're going to look and say, well, you know what, that guy's got all these or that girl's got all these and go get them.
sentences.zh: 并没有一张统一的“可陈述事实”清单，让我们看一眼就说，好吧，那个人有这些特征，或者那个女孩有这些特征，然后去抓他们。

sentences.en: Basically, immigration officers must have a reasonable suspicion that somebody is in the country illegally to be able to stop them and question them about their status.
sentences.zh: 基本上，移民官员必须有“合理怀疑”某人非法居留，才能拦截并询问其身份。

sentences.en: But it's the basis for that reasonable suspicion that has led to allegations that Border Patrol agents in Los Angeles have racially profiled people.
sentences.zh: 但正是这种“合理怀疑”的依据，导致了洛杉矶边境巡逻人员对民众进行种族定性的指控。

sentences.en: That's something that Greg Bovino and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那是格雷格·博维诺（Greg Bovino）和美国

sentences.en: Border Patrol disputed.
sentences.zh: 边境巡逻队所反驳的。

sentences.en: We're not looking at any one thing.
sentences.zh: 我们不是只看某单一因素。

sentences.en: We like the compendium of facts.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢事实的综合体。

sentences.en: We like a lot of different facts put together, the outward-facing characteristics of an individual.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢将许多不同的事实放在一起，观察一个人的外在特征。

sentences.en: Do they turn and run?
sentences.zh: 他们会转身逃跑吗？

sentences.en: Is that an articulable fact?
sentences.zh: 那是一个可陈述的事实吗？

sentences.en: So, but let's say you're at a Home Depot and you've got the criminals that you've targeted, you're arresting,
sentences.zh: 那么，假设你在家得宝，你锁定了你要逮捕的罪犯，

sentences.en: and then next to them are people who apparently appear to be Latino, they speak Spanish.
sentences.zh: 然后他们旁边的人看起来像是拉丁裔，他们说西班牙语。

sentences.en: Would that be enough to kind of start questioning and figuring out whether or not to arrest them?
sentences.zh: 这足以开始盘问并判断是否要逮捕他们吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Hamad, I talk to, and our agents talk to people that are, as you say, Latino or speak Spanish every day.
sentences.zh: 哈马德，我和我们的探员每天都在和你说的那种拉丁裔或说西班牙语的人交谈。

sentences.en: And a lot of those folks are legal permanent residents.
sentences.zh: 其中许多人是合法的永久居民。

sentences.en: They have legal documents.
sentences.zh: 他们有合法证件。

sentences.en: It happens all the time.
sentences.zh: 这种情况经常发生。

sentences.en: Not a big deal to us if someone speaks Spanish.
sentences.zh: 如果有人说西班牙语，对我们来说没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: I speak Spanish.
sentences.zh: 我也说西班牙语。

sentences.en: Not the greateSt.
sentences.zh: 不是最流利的。

sentences.en: His contention, his main thing to push back on that is this idea that the idea of just speaking Spanish is not enough for them to arrest somebody.
sentences.zh: 他的论点，他反驳这一点的主要依据是，仅仅会说西班牙语不足以让他们逮捕某人。

sentences.en: He points to, hey, we've arrested people from Europe, including from Poland.
sentences.zh: 他指出，嘿，我们逮捕过来自欧洲的人，包括来自波兰的人。

sentences.en: So we're not racially profiling in the way that people are saying that we do.
sentences.zh: 所以我们并没有像人们所说的那样进行种族定性。

sentences.en: I can't speak Polish, but guess what I can do?
sentences.zh: 我不会说波兰语，但你猜我能做什么？

sentences.en: I can gather those needed legal articulable facts to put together that that individual is an illegal alien from Poland.
sentences.zh: 我可以收集那些必要的法律上的可陈述事实，拼凑出那个人是一个来自波兰的非法移民。

sentences.en: What do you make of that response, Hamad?
sentences.zh: 你对这个回应怎么看，哈马德？

sentences.en: Because when you hear that Border Patrol agents are showing up at a Home Depot and picking people up because they look Latino, it's hard to see how that isn't profiling.
sentences.zh: 因为当你听说边境巡逻人员出现在家得宝，仅仅因为人们看起来像拉丁裔就抓人时，很难看出这怎么不是定性。

sentences.en: And, of course, we're hearing that the people they're picking up are often Latino citizens of the United States.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们当然听说他们抓的人往往是拉丁裔的美国公民。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, the reality is that in the arrests that we've seen in Los Angeles and elsewhere, they are picking up people oftentimes who are Latino.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，现实情况是，在我们看到的洛杉矶和其他地方的逮捕行动中，他们抓的人往往是拉丁裔。

sentences.en: And these core questions of when and where Border Patrol and immigration enforcement agents can make arrests went all the way to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 而关于边境巡逻队和移民执法人员何时何地可以进行逮捕的这些核心问题，一直闹到了最高法院。

sentences.en: And tell us what happened there.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们那里发生了什么。

sentences.en: So a federal court judge had limited the way Department of Homeland Security could operate in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 一位联邦法院法官限制了国土安全部在洛杉矶的行动方式。

sentences.en: But the Supreme Court blocked that order temporarily.
sentences.zh: 但最高法院暂时阻止了该命令。

sentences.en: And in his opinion,
sentences.zh: 在他的意见书中，

sentences.en: Justice Kavanaugh said that it wasn't the role of the federal court judge to tell the government what it could and could not do when it came to immigration enforcement.
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺（Kavanaugh）大法官表示，告诉政府在移民执法方面能做什么和不能做什么，不是联邦法院法官的角色。

sentences.en: And, of course, I think this ruling really kind of emboldened the Department of Homeland Security and Greg Bovino to continue with their actions in Los Angeles and elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 当然，我认为这一裁决确实在某种程度上鼓舞了国土安全部和格雷格·博维诺，让他们继续在洛杉矶和其他地方采取行动。

sentences.en: This is Kavanaugh basically agreeing with Bovino's argument that ethnicity is a legitimate factor that can be used as agents are out there deciding who to question on the streets.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是卡瓦诺同意了博维诺的观点，即族裔是一个合法的考量因素，探员在街头决定盘问谁时可以使用。

sentences.en: So Bovino gets this legal validation from the highest court, at least temporarily.
sentences.zh: 所以博维诺从最高法院获得了法律认可，至少是暂时的。

sentences.en: He's got the administration's backing.
sentences.zh: 他得到了政府的支持。

sentences.en: What does he do with that?
sentences.zh: 他会怎么做？

sentences.en: Well, of course, they continue going hard in Los Angeles, hitting Home Depots and car washes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，他们继续在洛杉矶采取强硬手段，冲击家得宝和洗车店。

sentences.en: But the Trump administration decides it's time for Bovino and his agents to go from Los Angeles to Chicago, where they take things up a level.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普政府决定是时候让博维诺和他的探员从洛杉矶转战芝加哥了，在那里他们将行动升级了。

sentences.en: Hard to see, but there's a helicopter right there on this building.
sentences.zh: 很难看清，但那栋楼上确实有一架直升机。

sentences.en: Early on in their time in Chicago in September, they do this operation unlike anything I've ever seen before.
sentences.zh: 9月份他们刚到芝加哥时，就进行了这样一次我从未见过的行动。

sentences.en: And that helicopter has just inserted snipers for the protection of all these federal agents you can see entering the building.
sentences.zh: 那架直升机刚刚投放了狙击手，以保护你所看到的进入大楼的所有联邦探员。

sentences.en: Hundreds of agents surround an apartment complex.
sentences.zh: 数百名探员包围了一个公寓大楼。

sentences.en: They film a video showing agents rappelling down from a helicopter, you know, bright spotlights.
sentences.zh: 他们拍摄了一段视频，显示探员从直升机上垂降，你知道，明亮的探照灯。

sentences.en: It really looks like an action movie, something like a Michael Bay film.
sentences.zh: 这看起来真的很像动作片，就像迈克尔·贝（Michael Bay）的电影一样。

sentences.en: This is Bovino having his Hollywood moment.
sentences.zh: 这就是博维诺的“好莱坞时刻”。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But that operation engenders a huge response as well, right?
sentences.zh: 但那次行动也引发了巨大的反响，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, this is something people saw as particularly cruel.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们认为这特别残忍。

sentences.en: I remember the images.
sentences.zh: 我还记得那些画面。

sentences.en: There were people, children, pulled out of their homes in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 有人，包括孩子，在半夜被从家里拖出来。

sentences.en: How does Bovino see this operation?
sentences.zh: 博维诺是如何看待这次行动的？

sentences.en: He's very proud of it.
sentences.zh: 他对此感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: That was a highly successful operation, Hamad.
sentences.zh: 那是一次非常成功的行动，哈马德。

sentences.en: Remember, there was a lot of American citizens in that apartment building that were being preyed upon by violent gang members.
sentences.zh: 记住，那栋公寓楼里有很多美国公民正受到暴力帮派成员的侵害。

sentences.en: So, I'm very, extremely proud of that large scale of an operation.
sentences.zh: 所以，我非常、极其为那次大规模行动感到自豪。

sentences.en: You know, he sees the operation as one in which they got rid of bad people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他认为这次行动是他们清除了坏人。

sentences.en: And this is exactly the type of work that they should be doing.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他们应该做的工作类型。

sentences.en: This was a success.
sentences.zh: 这是一次成功。

sentences.en: Kudos to the agents there.
sentences.zh: 为那里的探员点赞。

sentences.en: They've made that part of the city a safer place.
sentences.zh: 他们让城市的那一部分变得更安全了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think a lot of folks would agree there with that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为很多人会同意这一点。

sentences.en: And was it a success, actually?
sentences.zh: 那它真的成功了吗？

sentences.en: Like, what do we know about that?
sentences.zh: 比如，我们对此了解多少？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, like we talked about before with collateral arrests that happened here, in some of the reporting that I've done,
sentences.zh: 所以，就像我们之前谈到的这里发生的连带逮捕一样，在我做的一些报道中，

sentences.en: I found at least a few of the people who were arrested had no criminal background.
sentences.zh: 我发现至少有几名被捕者没有任何犯罪背景。

sentences.en: There were families who were arrested as well.
sentences.zh: 也有家庭被捕。

sentences.en: But the administration has not, in the months since, given us any breakdown or any details of what happened and the individuals who were detained.
sentences.zh: 但在随后的几个月里，政府没有给我们任何关于所发生事件的细分或细节，也没有提供被拘留者的信息。

sentences.en: So, I think, you know, this operation in many ways symbolizes the immigration debate in the country.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为，你知道，这次行动在许多方面象征着国内的移民辩论。

sentences.en: You know, for one portion of the country, this was an overreach.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对于国内的一部分人来说，这是一种越权。

sentences.en: Law enforcement agents rappelling down from helicopters, arresting a bunch of people at random at times, completely inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 执法人员从直升机上垂降，有时随机逮捕一大群人，这完全不合适。

sentences.en: Whereas for Bovino and supporters of the Trump administration, this is exactly what should happen.
sentences.zh: 而对于博维诺和特朗普政府的支持者来说，这正是应该发生的事情。

sentences.en: Ultimately, if you're in the country illegally and you're arrested, that's the exact thing that should happen.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，如果你非法居留并被捕，那正是应该发生的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is very much in line with the White House's policy of zero tolerance.
sentences.zh: 是的，这非常符合白宫的“零容忍”政策。

sentences.en: You know, if you committed the crime of crossing the border illegally, the administration is going to go after you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你犯了非法越境的罪，政府就会追究你的责任。

sentences.en: And they say, look, this is what people voted for.
sentences.zh: 他们说，看，这就是人们投票支持的。

sentences.en: Bovino is just following through on that.
sentences.zh: 博维诺只是在执行这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Bovino, DHS, ICE, the administration.
sentences.zh: 博维诺、国土安全部、移民及海关执法局、政府。

sentences.en: When they're talking about their crackdown on immigration, at the forefront, they want to talk about people with criminal records.
sentences.zh: 当他们谈论打击移民时，他们首先想谈论的是有犯罪记录的人。

sentences.en: But when you point to people who don't have criminal records, they say, well, those people crossed illegally and they're in the country without any form of status.
sentences.zh: 但当你指出那些没有犯罪记录的人时，他们会说，好吧，那些人是非法越境的，他们没有任何身份就待在国内。

sentences.en: They should be arrested as well.
sentences.zh: 他们也应该被逮捕。

sentences.en: There's there's no forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 没有，没有宽恕。

sentences.en: And what about any legal challenges to these tactics?
sentences.zh: 那么对这些战术有什么法律挑战吗？

sentences.en: Where are the courts on this today?
sentences.zh: 法院今天对此持什么态度？

sentences.en: Yeah, there are lawsuits in Illinois right now over the use of force by Border Patrol agents there, which has really been a hallmark of their operation.
sentences.zh: 是的，伊利诺伊州目前有关于边境巡逻人员使用武力的诉讼，这确实是他们行动的一个标志。

sentences.en: Bovino was recently actually called to testify in that case where a judge seems particularly skeptical that it was necessary for agents to use force on the streets during their operations.
